findings.evidence: editNote, lines 195–203, returns with “Pick a star to save” when countScored is zero; flushNote, lines 206–210, also requires a score. The textarea at lines 396–407 uses these handlers. In contrast, rush.rate_group_case_applicant in supabase/migrations/20261016191000_grading_contract_consistency.sql:267–279 accepts zero scores when clean_note is present.
findings.userImpact: A reviewer with a useful observation but insufficient basis for a numeric judgment cannot save that observation alone. Leaving the page loses the in-memory note; selecting an unsupported score merely to save undermines evidence integrity.
findings.suggestedFix: Save nonblank notes with all criterion scores null through the existing RPC. Keep these explicitly partial and outside valid-completion counts; verify note-only persistence after reload and keyboard blur.

findings.evidence: submit at lines 231–234 only sets reviewing. Lines 378–395 insert the review summary before the existing submit button, whose label changes at lines 398–399. No focus transfer or review-region live announcement accompanies this transition.
findings.userImpact: Keyboard focus remains on the now-final confirmation control. Forward Tab bypasses the newly inserted summary, and another Enter can lock the evaluation without guiding the reviewer through the ratings and evidence. This is a source-derived risk, not a reproduced browser observation.
findings.suggestedFix: Focus a programmatically focusable review heading when entering review, arrange confirmation after the summary, and restore useful focus on Keep editing. Add a focused keyboard-path check for review, editing and locking.
